about: Texts with the label and the tags the app reads of each: `label` is the key of the app's label index (lowercase), `label_text` what item code sees as `label`, `tags` what it sees as `tags_raw`. Both readers run over it: the app (tests/e2e/sparkle.spec.ts saves each text as an item and takes the reading from the page) and the vault's item watcher (tests/test_mindpage_reading.py over lib/mindpage_reading.py). A row is added to both by adding it here.
